public class Main {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		FastReader s = new FastReader();
		int tc = s.nextInt();
		while(tc-- > 0) {
			int n = s.nextInt();
			boolean[] taken = new boolean[n + 1];
			int[] input = new int[n];
			for(int i = 0;i < n;i++) input[i] = s.nextInt();
			int min = 1;
			ArrayList<Integer> arr = new ArrayList<>();
			TreeSet<Integer> ts = new TreeSet<>();
			for(int i = 1;i <= n;i++) ts.add(i);
			arr.add(input[0]);
			taken[input[0]] = true;
			ts.remove(input[0]);
			for(int i = 1;i < n;i++) {
				if(input[i] != input[i - 1]) {
					taken[input[i]] = true;
					arr.add(input[i]);
					ts.remove(input[i]);
				}
				else {
					arr.add(ts.pollFirst());
				}
			}
			for(int i : arr) System.out.print(i + " ");
			System.out.println();
			ts = new TreeSet<>();
			for(int i = 1;i <= n;i++) ts.add(i);
			arr = new ArrayList<>();
			int max = input[0] - 1;
			taken = new boolean[n + 1];
			taken[input[0]] = true;
			arr.add(input[0]);
			ts = new TreeSet<>();
			for(int i = 0;i < n;i++) taken[input[i]] = true;
			for(int i = 1;i <= n;i++) {
				if(!taken[i]) ts.add(i);
			}
			for(int i = 1;i < n;i++) {
				if(input[i] != input[i - 1]) {
					taken[input[i]] = true;
					arr.add(input[i]);
				}
				else {
					int val = ts.floor(input[i]);
					ts.remove(val);
					arr.add(val);
				}
			}
			for(int i : arr) System.out.print(i + " ");
			System.out.println();
		}
	}
	// 3 2 1 4
	// 3 3 3 4

	// 3 2 4 1
	// 3 3 4 4
	// 3 1 4 2

	public static String[] findsub(String str , int si , int ei) {
		if(si > ei) {
			String[] arr = new String[0];
			return arr;
		}
		if(str.length() == 0) {
			String[] arr = new String[1];
			return arr;
		}
		// i have two options
		String[] first = findsub(str , si + 1 , ei);
		String[] second = findsub(str , si , ei - 1);
		String[] ans = new String[first.length + second.length + 1];
		ans[ans.length - 1] = str.substring(si, ei + 1);
		int i= 0;
		//System.out.println("fl = " + first.length + " sl = " + second.length);
		for(;i < first.length;i++) ans[i] = first[i]; // i = first.length
		for(;i < ans.length - 1;i++) ans[i] = second[i - first.length]; // first.length + second.length
		System.out.println("-----");
		for(String s : ans) System.out.println(s);

		return ans;

	}

	public static long fact(int n) {
		long mul = 1;
		for(int i = 1;i <= n;i++) mul *= i;
		return mul;
	}

	public static long nc2(long k) {
		return (k*(k - 1))/2;
	}

}
class store3 {
	long sumodd;
	long sumeven;
	int minodd = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
	int mineven = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
}
class FastReader 
{ 
	BufferedReader br; 
	StringTokenizer st; 

	public FastReader() 
	{ 
		br = new BufferedReader(new
				InputStreamReader(System.in)); 
	} 

	String next() 
	{ 
		while (st == null || !st.hasMoreElements()) 
		{ 
			try
			{ 
				st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine()); 
			} 
			catch (IOException  e) 
			{ 
				e.printStackTrace(); 
			} 
		} 
		return st.nextToken(); 
	} 

	int nextInt() 
	{ 
		return Integer.parseInt(next()); 
	} 

	long nextLong() 
	{ 
		return Long.parseLong(next()); 
	} 

	double nextDouble() 
	{ 
		return Double.parseDouble(next()); 
	} 

	String nextLine() 
	{ 
		String str = ""; 
		try
		{ 
			str = br.readLine(); 
		} 
		catch (IOException e) 
		{ 
			e.printStackTrace(); 
		} 
		return str; 
	} 
}
